definitions.explanation: A pattern consisting of parallel lines or bands of color. Refers to the visual design itself, used for fabric, clothing, and decorative surfaces.

examples.japanese: {縞模様|しまもよう}のシャツを{買|か}った。
{青|あお}と{白|しろ}の{縞模様|しまもよう}がきれいだ。
examples.english: The blue and white stripes are beautiful.

examples.japanese: このネクタイは{細|ほそ}い{縞模様|しまもよう}が{入|はい}っていて、フォーマルな{場面|ばめん}にも{合|あ}う。
examples.english: This tie has thin stripes and is suitable even for formal occasions.

notes:
A compound of {縞|しま} (stripes) and {模様|もよう} (pattern; design). While {縞|しま} alone can mean stripes, {縞模様|しまもよう} is the full standard form used when describing fabric patterns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {縞模様|しまもよう}のシャツ: striped shirt
- {縞模様|しまもよう}のネクタイ: striped tie
- {縞模様|しまもよう}が{入|はい}る: to have stripes (lit. stripes enter)
- {横縞|よこじま}{模様|もよう}: horizontal stripes
- {縦縞|たてじま}{模様|もよう}: vertical stripes

RELATED PATTERN WORDS:
- {水玉模様|みずたまもよう}: polka-dot pattern
- {花柄|はながら}: floral pattern
- {格子模様|こうしもよう}: checkered pattern; plaid
- {無地|むじ}: solid color; plain (no pattern)
